name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Plan parallel lanes and atomic commits with a consistent clickable task index for every plan.

interface.shortDescription: Plan parallel worktrees and draft bounded agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Partition implementation goals into broad parallel lanes and atomic commit units; map every task one-to-one to a commit and coding-agent prompt; always create a temporary clickable task index and kebab-case task files regardless of plan size; derive lane and commit DAGs; and advance work through human-approved Kahn scheduling.
capabilities: One structured commit per dispatched task
interface.defaultPrompt: Partition this goal into broad parallel lanes and atomic commit-sized tasks, always create and link a temporary task index plus one kebab-case file per task, map every task one-to-one to an outcome-based commit without internal graph IDs, and guide manual Kahn execution.
